# Asclepius

> Typed FHIR R4 teaching kit. Zod is the source of truth; ports and adapters;
> DDI is incomplete by design. **NOT FOR CLINICAL USE.** Not a server for PHI.
> Not a substitute for Medplum, HAPI FHIR, or IBM FHIR.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): start here (disclaimer first)
- [docs/DESIGN-PIVOT.md](docs/DESIGN-PIVOT.md): why this is a teaching kit, not a clinical data platform
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): community contract (domain rules)
- [Architecture Decision Records](docs/adr/): first-principles choices
- [Copilot instructions](.github/copilot-instructions.md): never-do rules
- [SECURITY.md](.github/SECURITY.md): private vulnerability reports

## Verify

- `./scripts/verify.sh`
- `npm run gate`
